projects.title: Soup-of-Letters Book Generator
projects.description: A Python tool that generates paired word-search grids and exports ready-to-build LaTeX files using curated word lists and placement heuristics.
bullets: Generates paired puzzles by sampling.
Places words into 14x11 grids with randomized orientations and fills remaining cells using weighted letter distributions
Exports LaTeX (.tex) files

modal.title: Soup-of-Letters Book Generator
modal.sub: Batch soup-of-Letters generator with LaTeX export
modal.desc: Generates battle-style paired word-search puzzles from multilingual word lists (palavras.json), arranges words into grids, fills remaining cells with weighted letters, and writes LaTeX files for printing. Includes tooling to update word inventories and counters.

projects.title: Batalha Naval RPG
projects.description: Custom Battleship-style tactical RPG built with C++ and Qt for a Master's course. Features character classes, skill-based attacks, AI opponent logic, and online multiplayer support.
bullets: Turn-based naval combat with RPG elements: characters, passives, skills, action points and varied AOEs
Online multiplayer (client/server) with join-code decoding, lobby flow and TCP networking alongside local CPU opponent
Qt GUI with draggable ship placement, 12x12 board rendering, hit/miss tracking and visual feedback

cover.ariaLabel: Main menu / game board UI screenshot

modal.title: Batalha Naval RPG
modal.sub: Custom Battleship RPG developed for a Master's course
modal.desc: A Qt/C++ implementation of a Battleship-inspired tactical game with character-specific skills, AI and online play. Includes client/server networking, board/object management, and a polished UI.

projects.title: DBS Item Shop
projects.description: A online item shop developed for a Master's course. Implements user accounts, shopping cart and checkout flows, an admin area for product/user management, and multiple payment method integrations.
bullets: Full-stack PHP site with session-based auth, user profile management, shopping cart and order history
Admin panel for product and user management plus store endpoints for checkout and payment selection (MB Way, PayPal, Multibanco, etc.)
Server-side validation, templated includes (header/footer/head), and responsive UI for browsing and purchasing items

modal.title: DBS Item Shop
modal.desc: An item shop web application built with PHP and MySQL for a Master's course. Features include user registration/login, product pages, cart management, checkout with multiple payment methods, and an admin dashboard for managing products and users.
